x2 = 40.0

    (0, D_max),
    (L, D_max),
    (L, 0),
    (x2, 0),
    (x1, delta),
    (0, delta),
    (0, D_max)
]

profile = Polyline(pts)
face = make_face(profile)
part = extrude(face, amount=H)

# Shell first (open along -Y front faces)
front_faces = [f for f in part.faces() if f.normal_at(f.center()).Y < -0.5]
part = offset(part, amount=-t, openings=front_faces, kind=Kind.ARC)

# Fillet only the outer vertical edges (those far from the Y=0 front opening)
outer_vertical = [
    e for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    if min(v.Y for v in e.vertices()) > -0.1
    and max(abs(v.Y - D_max) for v in e.vertices()) < 0.1
    or max(v.Y for v in e.vertices()) > D_max - 0.1
]
# Simpler: fillet vertical edges whose midpoint Y is near the back or near full-depth side walls
vert_edges = []
for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z):
    ys = [v.Y for v in e.vertices()]
    # Outer rear edge (Y ~ D_max) or outer side edges (X near 0 or L)
    xs = [v.X for v in e.vertices()]
    if min(ys) > D_max - 0.5:
        vert_edges.append(e)

        # outer side wall only (Y close to D_max end)
        if max(ys) > D_max - 0.5:
            vert_edges.append(e)

if vert_edges:
    part = fillet(vert_edges, radius=R)

export_step(part, "output.step")

# ----- base plate -----
part = Box(length, width, base_thk,
           align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

for sx in (-1, 1):
    flange = Box(flange_thk, width, overall_h,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    flange = Pos(sx * (length / 2 - flange_thk / 2), 0, 0) * flange
    part += flange

    boss = Cylinder(boss_r, boss_h,

    boss = Rot(0, sx * 90, 0) * boss            # axis along X
    boss = Pos(x_inner, 0, hole_z) * boss
    part += boss

plate = extrude(Plane.YZ * profile, amount=t)

right = Pos(L / 2 - t, 0, 0) * plate
left  = mirror(right, Plane.YZ)

part = web + right + left

    lambda e: abs(e.center().Z - t) < 1e-6

L      = 80.0      # overall length
W      = 38.7      # overall depth of the channel
H      = 17.3      # overall height of the walls
T      = 1.8       # sheet thickness
RI     = 2.7       # inner bend radius  (5x R2.7)
RO     = 4.4       # outer bend radius  (2x R4.4)
HOLE_D = 4.5       # mounting hole      (4.50 THRU)
HOLE_X = 6.0       # hole centre from each end
HOLE_Z = 6.0       # hole centre height

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- U-channel cross-section drawn on Plane.YZ and extruded along X ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((0, H), (0, RO))
            CenterArc((RO, RO), RO, 180, 90)                 # outer fillet, left
            Line((RO, 0), (W - RO, 0))
            CenterArc((W - RO, RO), RO, 270, 90)             # outer fillet, right
            Line((W, RO), (W, H))
            Line((W, H), (W - T, H))                         # wall top
            Line((W - T, H), (W - T, T + RI))
            CenterArc((W - T - RI, T + RI), RI, 0, -90)      # inner fillet, right
            Line((W - T - RI, T), (T + RI, T))
            CenterArc((T + RI, T + RI), RI, 180, 90)         # inner fillet, left
            Line((T, T + RI), (T, H))
            Line((T, H), (0, H))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=L)

    # ---- 4.50 thru mounting holes in both side walls, near each end ----

        for hy in (T / 2, W - T / 2):

flange_thk   = 11.7     # flange thickness
hole_dia     = 9.2      # corner bolt holes, THRU
hole_pitch   = 40.0     # hole pattern spacing
tube_od      = 52.5     # boss outer diameter
bore_dia     = 30.0     # through bore
tube_h       = 57.5     # boss height above flange face
cham_corner  = 5.0      # 4x C5
cham_edge    = 1.2      # 8x C1.2

# ---- square flange ----
flange = Box(flange_size, flange_size, flange_thk,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
flange = chamfer(flange.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), cham_corner)

# ---- 4 corner holes ----
for sx in (-1, 1):
    for sy in (-1, 1):
        flange -= Pos(sx * hole_pitch / 2, sy * hole_pitch / 2, 0) * \
                  Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, flange_thk,
                           align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---- boss ----
tube = Pos(0, 0, flange_thk) * Cylinder(tube_od / 2, tube_h,
                                        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part = flange + tube

# ---- through bore ----

                                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---- 8x C1.2 : bottom outer perimeter edges ----
bottom_edges = [e for e in part.edges()
                if e.geom_type == GeomType.LINE and abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6]
part = chamfer(bottom_edges, cham_edge)

export_step(part, "output.step")

L = 80.0          # overall length (X)
W = 49.6          # overall depth  (Y)
H = 13.8          # overall height (Z)

edge_r  = 1.4     # 8x R1.4 rim edge radius

wall    = 3.9     # side wall thickness
floor_t = 3.0     # floor thickness

# corner screw holes  Ø4.1 THRU  (13.8 / 3.9 from edges)
hx1, hy1 = 13.8, 3.9
# small holes Ø3.4 THRU (5.5 from edges)
hx2 = 5.5

# large through hole
big_x, big_y, big_d = 53.8, 24.8, 16.5

# ---------------- outer body ----------------
outer = extrude(RectangleRounded(L, W, outer_r), H)

perim = [e for e in outer.edges()
         if abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6 or abs(e.center().Z - H) < 1e-6]
outer = fillet(perim, edge_r)

# ---------------- cavity ----------------
inner_r = max(outer_r - wall, 0.5)
cav = extrude(Plane.XY.offset(floor_t) *
              RectangleRounded(L - 2 * wall, W - 2 * wall, inner_r), H)

part = outer - cav

# ---------------- corner bosses ----------------
boss_sk = None
for sx in (1, -1):
    for sy in (1, -1):
        px = 8.0 if sx > 0 else L - 8.0
        py = 5.0 if sy > 0 else W - 5.0
        r = Pos(px, py) * Rectangle(16.0, 10.0)
        boss_sk = r if boss_sk is None else boss_sk + r

bosses = extrude(boss_sk, H) & outer
part = part + bosses

# ---------------- holes ----------------
# 4x Ø4.1 THRU
for sx in (1, -1):
    for sy in (1, -1):
        x = hx1 if sx > 0 else L - hx1
        y = hy1 if sy > 0 else W - hy1
        part -= Pos(x, y, -1) * Cylinder(4.1 / 2, H + 2,
                                         align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# 4x Ø3.4 THRU
for sx in (1, -1):
    for sy in (1, -1):
        x = hx2 if sx > 0 else L - hx2
        y = hy1 if sy > 0 else W - hy1
        part -= Pos(x, y, -1) * Cylinder(3.4 / 2, H + 2,
                                         align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# Ø16.5 THRU (through the floor)
part -= Pos(big_x, big_y, -1) * Cylinder(big_d / 2, H + 2,
                                         align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- small pad on inner wall (4.5 wide, 4.8 high) ----------------
pad = Pos(wall + 2.25, 24.8, floor_t + 2.4) * Box(4.5, 4.5, 4.8)
part += pad

# ---------------- export ----------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---- Overall ----
L = 86.0          # length  (X)
W = 49.6          # width   (Y)
H = 13.8          # height  (Z)
CORNER_R = 4.1    # 4x R4.1 outer corners

# ---- Pocket / wall ----
WALL = 5.5                   # rim / wall thickness
FLOOR = 3.9                  # remaining floor thickness
POCKET_DEPTH = H - FLOOR     # 9.9 deep cavity
BOT_R = 1.4                  # 8x R1.4 bottom perimeter rounds

# ---- Corner holes ----
HOLE_D = 3.4
CBORE_D = 4.1
CBORE_DEPTH = 5.5
HOLE_X = 13.8                # from outer edge
HOLE_Y = 5.5                 # from outer edge
LOBE_R = 5.0                 # boss lobe around each corner hole

# ---- Center hole ----
BIG_HOLE_D = 16.5
BIG_X = 53.8                 # from left edge
BIG_Y = 24.8                 # centered on width

# ---- Internal boss ----
BOSS_W = 4.5
BOSS_L = 10.0
BOSS_H = 4.8

# Convert edge distances -> centered coordinates
hx = L/2 - HOLE_X            # 29.2
hy = W/2 - HOLE_Y            # 19.3

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # Base slab
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        RectangleRounded(L, W, CORNER_R)
    extrude(amount=H)

    # 8x R1.4 along the bottom perimeter
    bottom_edges = bp.edges().filter_by(Plane.XY).group_by(Axis.Z)[0]
    fillet(bottom_edges, radius=BOT_R)

    # Cavity (rounded rect minus lobes so material remains around screw holes)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(H)):
        RectangleRounded(L - 2 * WALL, W - 2 * WALL, 10.0)
        with Locations((hx, hy), (hx, -hy), (-hx, hy), (-hx, -hy)):
            Circle(LOBE_R, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=-POCKET_DEPTH, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Internal boss, 4.8 high, attached to inner wall
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(FLOOR)):
        with Locations((-L/2 + WALL + BOSS_W/2, 0)):
            Rectangle(BOSS_W, BOSS_L)
    extrude(amount=BOSS_H)

    # 4x Ø3.4 thru + Ø4.1 c'bore 5.5 deep
    with Locations((hx, hy, H), (hx, -hy, H), (-hx, hy, H), (-hx, -hy, H)):
        CounterBoreHole(radius=HOLE_D / 2,
                        counter_bore_radius=CBORE_D / 2,
                        counter_bore_depth=CBORE_DEPTH)

    # Ø16.5 thru
    with Locations((BIG_X - L/2, BIG_Y - W/2)):
        Cylinder(BIG_HOLE_D / 2, 2 * H, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

tip_r     = 2.6             # blade tip / edge radius
blade_t   = 2 * tip_r       # resulting blade thickness
sweep_ang = math.radians(55.0)   # blade curvature (wrap angle)

r_in  = hub_r - 1.0         # blades root slightly inside the hub
r_out = outer_r

# ---------------- blade profile (curved plate, constant thickness) --------
def path_pt(t):
    r = r_in + (r_out - r_in) * t
    a = sweep_ang * (t ** 1.4)
    return r * math.cos(a), r * math.sin(a)

N = 48
out_pts, in_pts = [], []
for i in range(N + 1):
    t = i / N
    x, y = path_pt(t)

    # tangent by finite difference -> normal offset (safe at endpoints)
    if t < 0.5:
        u = min(t + 1e-4, 1.0)
        x2, y2 = path_pt(u)
        dx, dy = x2 - x, y2 - y
    else:
        u = max(t - 1e-4, 0.0)
        x0, y0 = path_pt(u)
        dx, dy = x - x0, y - y0

    L = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    if L < 1e-12:
        dx, dy = 1.0, 0.0
        L = 1.0
    dx, dy = dx / L, dy / L
    nx, ny = -dy, dx
    hw = blade_t / 2.0
    out_pts.append((x + nx * hw, y + ny * hw))

L = 73.0            # overall length
W = 46.4            # overall width
H = 6.7             # overall height
wall_t = 1.0        # wall thickness
floor_t = 1.0       # floor thickness
rib_w = 1.1         # rib thickness
rib_positions = [7.0, 20.2, 33.4, 46.6, 59.8]  # rib center positions from left
hole_d = 3.2        # side hole diameter
hole_pitch = 13.2   # hole pitch
n_holes = 6         # number of side holes

# --- Outer shell ---
part = Box(L, W, H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# --- Inner cavity (open top) ---
cavity = Box(L - 2 * wall_t, W - 2 * wall_t, H - floor_t,
             align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
cavity = Pos(wall_t, wall_t, floor_t) * cavity
part = part - cavity

# --- Internal ribs (running across the width) ---
for x in rib_positions:
    rib = Box(rib_w, W - 2 * wall_t, H - floor_t,
              align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
    rib = Pos(x - rib_w / 2, wall_t, floor_t) * rib
    part = part + rib

# --- Six holes through the front long wall ---
start_x = (L - (n_holes - 1) * hole_pitch) / 2
for i in range(n_holes):
    x = start_x + i * hole_pitch
    hole = Cylinder(radius=hole_d / 2, height=3 * wall_t,

    hole = Pos(x, 0, H / 2) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * hole

# --- Small corner rounds (4x R0.1) on vertical edges of the box ---
vert_edges = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)

import math

# ---------------- dimensions ----------------
overall   = 80.0            # width across lobes (both axes)
half      = overall / 2.0   # 40
bc_r      = 57.1 / 2.0      # bolt circle radius = 28.55
lobe_r    = half - bc_r     # 11.45 lobe radius
thk       = 5.7             # plate thickness
c_hole_r  = 41.9 / 2.0      # central through bore
hole_r    = 5.4 / 2.0       # 4x small through holes
cham      = 1.9             # 8x C1.9

# concave side arc: centred on nominal 80x80 corner, tangent to both lobes
d_c2l     = math.hypot(half, half - bc_r)
concave_r = d_c2l - lobe_r
off       = concave_r / math.sqrt(2.0)

lobe = {0.0: (bc_r, 0.0), 90.0: (0.0, bc_r),
        180.0: (-bc_r, 0.0), 270.0: (0.0, -bc_r)}
cor = {'ne': (half, half), 'nw': (-half, half),
       'sw': (-half, -half), 'se': (half, -half)}

def tp(c, l):
    """tangent point of concave arc (centre c) with lobe circle (centre l)"""
    dx, dy = l[0] - c[0], l[1] - c[1]
    d = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    return (c[0] + concave_r * dx / d, c[1] + concave_r * dy / d)

T_tl = tp(cor['nw'], lobe[90.0])
T_tr = tp(cor['ne'], lobe[90.0])
T_rt = tp(cor['ne'], lobe[0.0])
T_rb = tp(cor['se'], lobe[0.0])
T_br = tp(cor['se'], lobe[270.0])
T_bl = tp(cor['sw'], lobe[270.0])
T_lb = tp(cor['sw'], lobe[180.0])
T_lt = tp(cor['nw'], lobe[180.0])

m_ne = (half - off,  half - off)
m_se = (half - off, -half + off)
m_sw = (-half + off, -half + off)
m_nw = (-half + off,  half - off)

with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            ThreePointArc(T_tl, (0, half), T_tr)      # top lobe
            ThreePointArc(T_tr, m_ne, T_rt)           # NE concave side
            ThreePointArc(T_rt, (half, 0), T_rb)      # right lobe
            ThreePointArc(T_rb, m_se, T_br)           # SE concave side
            ThreePointArc(T_br, (0, -half), T_bl)     # bottom lobe
            ThreePointArc(T_bl, m_sw, T_lb)           # SW concave side
            ThreePointArc(T_lb, (-half, 0), T_lt)     # left lobe
            ThreePointArc(T_lt, m_nw, T_tl)           # NW concave side
        make_face()
        Circle(c_hole_r, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
        with Locations((bc_r, 0), (0, bc_r), (-bc_r, 0), (0, -bc_r)):
            Circle(hole_r, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=thk)

    # chamfer the outer profile edges (top and bottom) - 8x C1.9
    edge_list = []
    for e in bp.part.edges():
        if (e.position_at(0) - e.position_at(1)).length < 1e-9:

        zs = [v.Z for v in e.vertices()]

bore_dia = 68.4           # Ø68.4 THRU

n_slots = 12              # 12 slots (12x R1.0 on slot roots)

# Slot rectangle: root at r = slot_root_r, extending past OD for clean cut
slot_len = (outer_dia / 2 + 2.0) - slot_root_r        # 42 - 35 = 7
slot_center_r = (slot_root_r + outer_dia / 2 + 2.0) / 2  # (35+42)/2 = 38.5

with BuildPart() as ring:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(radius=outer_dia / 2)
        Circle(radius=bore_dia / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
        with PolarLocations(radius=slot_center_r, count=n_slots, rotate=True):
            Rectangle(slot_len, slot_width, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=width)

    # These edges lie at sqrt(slot_root_r^2 + (slot_width/2)^2) from Z axis.

        r = hypot(c.X, c.Y)
        if abs(r - target_r) < 0.01:
            root_edges.append(e)

    fillet(root_edges, radius=fillet_r)

part = ring.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

total_height = 20.8     # overall height (Z)
hole_dia     = 9.8      # through-hole diameter
hole_x       = 57.0     # hole centre from the left face
fillet_r     = 4.2      # corner radius (19x R4.2)

# ---- L-shaped profile in the X-Z plane (drawn as XY, then remapped) ----
pts = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (length, 0.0),
    (length, base_height),
    (wall_thick, base_height),
    (wall_thick, total_height),
    (0.0, total_height),
]
profile = make_face(Polyline(*pts, close=True))

# ---- round every convex profile corner (all except the concave inner step) ----
round_verts = [
    v for v in profile.vertices()
    if not (abs(v.X - wall_thick) < 0.01 and abs(v.Y - base_height) < 0.01)

profile = fillet(round_verts, radius=fillet_r)

part = extrude(Plane.XZ * profile, amount=depth / 2, both=True)

# ---- Ø9.8 through-hole ----
hole = Pos(hole_x, 0, 0) * Cylinder(radius=hole_dia / 2, height=total_height * 4)
part = part - hole

export_step(part, "output.step")

# Part: stepped plate (staircase plan form), all outer edges R4.2,
#       one Ø9.8 through hole.

#   - Thickness 20.8 (from the front / side view)

R   = 4.2         # edge fillet radius (19x R4.2)
HD  = 9.8         # through hole diameter
HX  = 24.3        # hole X position (from front view / plan)
HY  = 20.0        # hole Y position

# plan outline (X, Y) - staircase, deepest section at the left
plan = [
    (0.0,   0.0),
    (W,     0.0),
    (W,     21.0),   # lowest step, front right
    (37.0,  21.0),
    (37.0,  46.0),   # middle step
    (30.0,  46.0),
    (30.0,  D - 8.0),# 8.0 from the back edge (side view)
    (22.1,  D - 8.0),
    (22.1,  D),      # full depth column
    (0.0,   D),
]

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- base solid -------------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*plan, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=T)

    # ---- R4.2 on the convex vertical (plan) corners ------------------
    convex_plan = [(0.0, 0.0), (W, 0.0), (W, 21.0), (37.0, 46.0),
                   (30.0, D - 8.0), (22.1, D), (0.0, D)]
    vert_edges = [
        e for e in bp.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
        if any((e.center() - Vector(cx, cy, e.center().Z)).length < 1e-6
               for cx, cy in convex_plan)
    ]
    fillet(vert_edges, radius=R)

    # ---- R4.2 on top and bottom perimeters ---------------------------
    horiz_edges = [e for e in bp.edges()
                   if abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6 or abs(e.center().Z - T) < 1e-6]
    fillet(horiz_edges, radius=R)

    # ---- Ø9.8 through hole -------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(-1.0)):
        with Locations((HX, HY)):
            Circle(HD / 2)
    extrude(amount=T + 2.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

import math
from build123d import *

# ---- dimensions from drawing ----
outer_dia = 80.0          # ø80.0
inner_dia = 67.4          # ø67.4
height = 12.6             # overall height
fillet_r = 6.3            # 6x R6.3 spoke-to-rim fillets
hub_r = 8.0               # central hub radius
square_hole = 6.0         # square shaft bore
spoke_hub_w = 5.0         # spoke width at hub
spoke_rim_w = 15.0        # spoke width at rim

outer_r = outer_dia / 2.0
inner_r = inner_dia / 2.0

with BuildPart() as wheel:
    with BuildSketch() as base_sk:
        # outer rim ring
        Circle(outer_r)
        Circle(inner_r, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
        # central hub
        Circle(hub_r)
        # 3 tapered spokes (one up, two down)
        for ang in (90.0, 210.0, 330.0):
            Polygon(
                (hub_r - 2.0, spoke_hub_w / 2.0),
                (outer_r + 2.0, spoke_rim_w / 2.0),
                (outer_r + 2.0, -spoke_rim_w / 2.0),
                (hub_r - 2.0, -spoke_hub_w / 2.0),
                rotation=ang,
                align=None,
            )
        # trim everything to the outer diameter
        Circle(outer_r, mode=Mode.INTERSECT)

        # fillet the six spoke/rim junctions
        spoke_verts = [
            v for v in base_sk.vertices()
            if abs(math.hypot(v.X, v.Y) - inner_r) < 0.8
        ]
        fillet(spoke_verts, radius=fillet_r)

    extrude(amount=height)

    # square drive bore through hub
    with BuildSketch():
        Rectangle(square_hole, square_hole)

import math

# ---- Dimensions from the drawing ----
length = 80.6          # overall length (80.6)
major_d = 6.0          # nominal / major diameter (Ø6.0)
pitch = 1.0            # standard M6 coarse pitch

# ---- Thread geometry (M6 x 1.0) ----
h = 0.613 * pitch                       # thread depth
r_major = major_d / 2
r_minor = r_major - h
r_helix = (r_major + r_minor) / 2

# Core cylinder (thread root diameter)
core = Cylinder(r_minor, length, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# Helical thread profile (trapezoid in the radial-axial plane)
crest = pitch / 2 - h * math.tan(math.radians(30))
pts = [
    (r_minor, -pitch / 2),
    (r_major, -crest),
    (r_major, crest),
    (r_minor, pitch / 2),
]
profile = Plane.XZ * make_face(Polyline(*pts, close=True))

helix = Helix(pitch=pitch, height=length, radius=r_helix)
thread = sweep(profile, path=helix)

part = core + thread

# ---- Chamfered end envelope (45° chamfers at both ends) ----
c = 1.0
env_pts = [
    (0, 0),
    (r_major - c, 0),
    (r_major, c),
    (r_major, length - c),
    (r_major - c, length),
    (0, length),
]
env_face = Plane.XZ * make_face(Polyline(*env_pts, close=True))
envelope = revolve(env_face, Axis.Z)

part = part & envelope

# Center the part on the origin
part = part.translate((0, 0, -length / 2))

export_step(part, "output.step")

R_HOLES    = 13.0      # bolt-circle radius of the satellite holes

# Star cross-section (hexagram outline: tip / valley vertices)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
def star_sketch(scale=1.0, z=0.0):
    pts = []
    for i in range(2 * N_POINTS):
        ang = math.radians(90.0 + i * 180.0 / N_POINTS)
        r = (R_TIP if i % 2 == 0 else R_VALLEY) * scale
        pts.append((r * math.cos(ang), r * math.sin(ang)))
    poly = Polygon(*pts, align=None)
    return Plane.XY.offset(z) * poly

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

middle = star_sketch(1.0,    0.0)
top    = star_sketch(TAPER,  THK / 2.0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
cutter = Pos(0, 0, 0) * Cylinder(D_CENTER / 2.0, THK * 4)

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # flange
    Cylinder(plate_dia / 2, plate_thk, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    # wide hub
    Cylinder(boss_dia / 2, boss_top_z, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    # spigot
    Cylinder(spigot_dia / 2, spigot_top_z, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    # hex head 8.0 A/F

    extrude(amount=total_height - spigot_top_z)

    # 8 x Ø8.0 thru holes equally spaced on Ø64.0 BC
    with Locations(Plane.XY.offset(-0.5)):

            Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, plate_thk + 1,
                     align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                     mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 22 x R0.5 rounds: 16 hole edges + 2 flange rims + 2 hub steps + 2 spigot steps

                      (hole_dia / 2, plate_dia / 2, boss_dia / 2, spigot_dia / 2)) < 1e-6
    )
    fillet(round_edges, radius=fillet_r)

bore_d   = 5.7      # Ø5.7 thru bore

fillet_r = 0.6      # 7x R0.6

# ---------------- axial stack-up ----------------
z1 = flange_t                 # 1.3
z2 = z1 + ring_t              # 2.6
z3 = z2 + step_t              # 3.7
z4 = z3 + flange_t            # 5.0
z5 = z4 + step_t              # 6.1
z6 = z5 + ring_t              # 7.4

# ---------------- revolved body ----------------
profile_pts = [
    (0.0,        0.0),
    (base_d / 2, 0.0),
    (base_d / 2, z1),
    (neck_d / 2, z1),
    (neck_d / 2, z2),
    (base_d / 2, z2),
    (base_d / 2, z3),
    (flange_d/2, z3),
    (flange_d/2, z4),
    (neck_d / 2, z4),
    (neck_d / 2, z5),
    (top_d  / 2, z5),
    (top_d  / 2, z6),
    (0.0,        z6),
    (0.0,        0.0),
]

with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*profile_pts)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # Ø5.7 thru bore
    Cylinder(bore_d / 2, total_h * 3, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 8x Ø6.3 thru holes, equally spaced on Ø68.6 BC (through the flange only)
    with Locations(Plane.XY.offset(z3 + flange_t / 2)):
        with PolarLocations(bc_d / 2, 8):
            Cylinder(hole_d / 2, flange_t + 0.2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # keyway / slot in the top boss (open from centre to the Ø22.9 edge)
    with Locations((neck_d / 4, 0, (z4 + z6) / 2)):

        ]
        fillet(slot_edges, radius=fillet_r)
    except Exception:
        pass

# Overall dimensions
W = 80.5          # overall width
D = 37.5          # overall depth
H = 54.9          # overall height
T = 1.4           # panel thickness (top, sides, drawers)
PED_W = 19.2      # pedestal width
LEG_H = 19.2      # open leg height (underside of pedestal box)
TOP_T = 1.4       # desk top thickness
PED_H = H - TOP_T # pedestal box height = 53.5

GAP = W - 2 * PED_W               # open knee space
x_left = -W / 2 + PED_W / 2       # left pedestal center
x_right = W / 2 - PED_W / 2       # right pedestal center


def make_pedestal(xc):
    """Build one pedestal (2 side/leg panels, back, bottom, 3 drawer fronts)."""
    x0 = xc - PED_W / 2
    x1 = xc + PED_W / 2
    y0 = -D / 2
    y1 = D / 2
    parts = []

    # Outer side panel (extends to floor as a leg)
    parts.append(Pos(x0 + T / 2, 0, PED_H / 2) * Box(T, D, PED_H))
    # Inner side panel (extends to floor as a leg)
    parts.append(Pos(x1 - T / 2, 0, PED_H / 2) * Box(T, D, PED_H))
    # Back panel
    parts.append(Pos(xc, y1 - T / 2, (LEG_H + PED_H) / 2) *
                 Box(PED_W - 2 * T, T, PED_H - LEG_H))
    # Bottom panel of the drawer box
    parts.append(Pos(xc, 0, LEG_H + T / 2) * Box(PED_W - 2 * T, D, T))

    # Three drawer fronts on the front face
    zi0 = LEG_H + T        # bottom of drawer stack
    zi1 = PED_H            # top of drawer stack
    gap = T                # gap between drawer fronts
    h = (zi1 - zi0 - 2 * gap) / 3
    z = zi1
    for _ in range(3):
        parts.append(Pos(xc, y0 + T / 2, z - h / 2) *
                     Box(PED_W - 2 * T, T, h))
        z -= (h + gap)

    return parts


shapes = [Pos(0, 0, H - TOP_T / 2) * Box(W, D, TOP_T)]
shapes += make_pedestal(x_left)
shapes += make_pedestal(x_right)

part = shapes[0]
for s in shapes[1:]:
    part = part + s

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions (from drawing) ----------------
W      = 80.5      # overall width (front view)
D      = 37.5      # depth of wing / pedestal (side view)
H      = 54.9      # overall height
T      = 1.4       # panel / desktop thickness
DW     = 19.2      # drawer front width
DH     = 13.9      # drawer front height
GAP    = 1.4       # gap between drawer fronts
APRON  = 5.5       # rail under desktop (5.5 callouts)
R      = 0.7       # 4x R0.7 corner fillets

PW     = 2 * T + DW                    # 22.0  pedestal width
PH     = H - T                         # 53.5  pedestal height
BASE   = PH - (APRON + 3 * DH + 2 * GAP)   # 3.5 bottom rail
FD     = 0.5                           # drawer front protrusion

# ---------------- L-shaped desktop ----------------
wing_a = Pos(0, 0, H - T) * Box(W, D, T, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
wing_b = Pos(W - D, 0, H - T) * Box(D, W, T, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
part = wing_a + wing_b

# ---------------- pedestal (local: width X, depth Y, front at Y=0) ----------------
def pedestal() -> Part:
    body = Box(PW, D, PH, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
    body = fillet(body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), R)      # 4x R0.7
    z = BASE
    for _ in range(3):                                    # three drawers
        body += Pos(T, -FD, z) * Box(DW, FD, DH,
                                     align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
        z += DH + GAP
    return body

# left pedestal of the main wing
part += pedestal()
# right (corner) pedestal of the main wing
part += Pos(W - PW, 0, 0) * pedestal()

export_step(part, "output.step")

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
W  = 34.1      # overall width  (X)
D  = 36.6      # overall depth  (Y)
H  = 80.0      # overall height (Z) of back wall
T  = 2.5       # plate thickness
SH = 65.9      # side wall height

BW, BZ0, BZ1 = 17.4, 19.9, 65.8   # back wall slot (width, z-bottom, z-top)
SW, SZ0, SZ1 = 13.0, 12.6, 47.4   # side wall slot, 2 x R6.5

# ---------------- main body ----------------
part  = Pos(W/2, D - T/2, H/2) * Box(W, T, H)      # back wall
part += Pos(W/2, D/2, T/2)     * Box(W, D, T)      # bottom wall
part += Pos(T/2, D/2, SH/2)    * Box(T, D, SH)     # left side wall
part += Pos(W - T/2, D/2, SH/2) * Box(T, D, SH)    # right side wall

# ---------------- slot cutter helper ----------------
def slot_cutter(z0, z1, w, length_y):
    """Stadium slot in the XZ plane, extruded along Y, centred at origin."""
    r = w / 2
    c  = Pos(0, 0, (z0 + z1) / 2) * Box(w, length_y, (z1 - z0) - w)
    c += Pos(0, 0, z0 + r) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(r, length_y)
    c += Pos(0, 0, z1 - r) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(r, length_y)
    return c

# back wall slot (through the 2.5 wall)
part -= Pos(W/2, D - T/2, 0) * slot_cutter(BZ0, BZ1, BW, 4 * T)

# side wall slots (rotated 90° so the slot lies in the YZ plane)
side_slot = Rot(0, 0, 90) * slot_cutter(SZ0, SZ1, SW, 4 * T)
part -= Pos(T/2, D/2, 0) * side_slot
part -= Pos(W - T/2, D/2, 0) * side_slot

export_step(part, "output.step")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

t   = 2.5       # material thickness

slot_z0 = 9.6
slot_r  = 3.6

# rear plate slot
slot_h2 = 65.9
slot_z2 = 12.6
slot_r2 = 6.5

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- front vertical plate ----
    with Locations((0, 0, 0)):
        Box(W, t, H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

    # ---- rear vertical plate ----
    with Locations((0, t + gap, 0)):
        Box(W2, t, H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

    # ---- bottom web joining the two plates ----
    with Locations((0, t, 0)):
        Box(W, gap, t, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

    # ---- slot through the front plate ----
    pl1 = Plane(origin=(0, t, 0), x_dir=(1, 0, 0), z_dir=(0, -1, 0))

    # ---- slot through the rear plate ----
    pl2 = Plane(origin=(0, t + gap + t + 1.0, 0), x_dir=(1, 0, 0), z_dir=(0, -1, 0))

def zigzag(r_tip, r_val, n, start=math.pi / 2.0):
    """Closed zigzag polygon: alternating tip/valley radii."""
    pts = []
    for i in range(2 * n):
        a = start + i * math.pi / n
        r = r_tip if i % 2 == 0 else r_val

inner_face = make_face(Polyline(*inner_pts, close=True))

import math

# --- Dimensions from drawing ---
outer_dia = 80.0      # tip diameter (also the 79.9 horizontal in section view)
root_dia  = 59.2      # root diameter
thickness = 15.3      # face width

twist_deg = 20.0      # helix twist across face width (from ISO view)

tip_r  = outer_dia / 2.0
root_r = root_dia / 2.0

def tooth_pts(rot_deg):
    """Star polygon alternating tip/root vertices, closed."""
    pts = []
    for i in range(2 * n_teeth):
        ang = math.radians(i * 180.0 / n_teeth + rot_deg)
        r = tip_r if i % 2 == 0 else root_r
        pts.append((r * math.cos(ang), r * math.sin(ang)))
    return pts

def root_verts(sk):
    return [v for v in sk.vertices()
            if abs(math.hypot(v.X, v.Y) - root_r) < 1.0]

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # Bottom section (unrotated)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk1:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*tooth_pts(0.0), close=True)
        make_face()
        fillet(root_verts(sk1), radius=fillet_r)

    # Top section (rotated by helix twist) at z = thickness
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(thickness)) as sk2:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*tooth_pts(twist_deg), close=True)
        make_face()
        fillet(root_verts(sk2), radius=fillet_r)

    # Loft between the two twisted sections -> helical teeth
    loft()

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---- Dimensions from the drawing ----
W        = 18.1     # plate / loop width
H        = 80.6     # overall height
T        = 1.3      # plate (sheet) thickness
DEPTH    = 8.9      # overall depth of the part
BLOCK_D  = DEPTH - T          # 7.6 forward projection of the loop block
LOOP_H   = 36.4               # loop block height (80.6 - 44.2)
LOOP_Z0  = H - LOOP_H         # 44.2  bottom of the loop block
BORDER   = 2.5                # frame wall thickness
WIN_W    = W - 2 * BORDER     # 13.1  window width
WIN_TOP  = H - BORDER         # 78.1  window top
WIN_BOT  = LOOP_Z0 + BORDER   # 46.7  window bottom
TONGUE_W = 10.4               # tongue width
R_SMALL  = 0.5                # 26x R0.5 edge rounds

# ---- Base plate ----
plate = Pos(0, T / 2, H / 2) * Box(W, T, H)

# ---- Loop block on the front face (top of the plate) ----
block = Pos(0, T + BLOCK_D / 2, LOOP_Z0 + LOOP_H / 2) * Box(W, BLOCK_D, LOOP_H)

# ---- Window cut straight through the block ----
window = Pos(0, T + BLOCK_D / 2, (WIN_BOT + WIN_TOP) / 2) * \
         Box(WIN_W, BLOCK_D + 2, WIN_TOP - WIN_BOT)

body = plate + block - window

# ---- Tongue hanging from the top rail, rounded at the bottom ----
tongue_top    = WIN_TOP           # attach to top rail
tongue_bottom = 60.0              # well inside the open window
tongue = Pos(0, T + BLOCK_D / 2, (tongue_top + tongue_bottom) / 2) * \
         Box(TONGUE_W, BLOCK_D, tongue_top - tongue_bottom)

# Round only the *bottom* edges (parallel to Y, at the lowest Z of the tongue)
bottom_edges = tongue.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y).group_by(Axis.Z)[0]
try:
    tongue = fillet(bottom_edges, radius=TONGUE_W / 2)
except Exception:
    tongue = fillet(bottom_edges, radius=2.0)

part = body + tongue

# ---- 26x R0.5 rounds on the vertical edges of the loop frame ----
try:
    vertical_edges = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    part = fillet(vertical_edges, radius=R_SMALL)
except Exception:
    pass

export_step(part, "output.step")

import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions read from the drawing ----------------
LOBE_D = 29.6                       # lobe outside diameter
LOBE_R = LOBE_D / 2.0               # 14.8
HOLE_D = 21.1                       # all four holes
HOLE_R = HOLE_D / 2.0               # 10.55
BC_D   = 58.2                       # bolt-circle diameter
BC_R   = BC_D / 2.0                 # 29.1
THK    = 6.6                        # overall thickness
WEB    = 2.8                        # web (recessed) thickness
RECESS = THK - WEB                  # 3.8 recess depth
RIM_W  = (LOBE_D - HOLE_D) / 2.0    # 4.25 ring / rim width

# ---------------- lobe centres (120 deg apart) ----------------
angles = [90.0, 210.0, 330.0]
L = [Vector(BC_R * math.cos(math.radians(a)), BC_R * math.sin(math.radians(a)))
     for a in angles]

def ang(v):
    return math.degrees(math.atan2(v.Y, v.X))

# ---------------- concave arc centres (between adjacent lobes) ----------------
Cc = []
for i in range(3):
    j = (i + 1) % 3
    mid = (L[i] + L[j]) / 2.0
    d = (L[i] - L[j]).length
    h = math.sqrt((2.0 * LOBE_R) ** 2 - (d / 2.0) ** 2)
    u = Vector(mid.X, mid.Y).normalized()
    Cc.append(mid + u * h)

def cc_of(a, b):
    return Cc[a] if (a + 1) % 3 == b else Cc[b]

def tang(i, j):
    C = cc_of(i, j)
    return L[i] + (C - L[i]).normalized() * LOBE_R

# ---------------- outer boundary wire ----------------
edges = []
for i in range(3):
    # convex outer arc of lobe i
    p1 = tang(i, (i - 1) % 3)
    p2 = tang(i, (i + 1) % 3)
    a1 = ang(p1 - L[i])
    a2 = ang(p2 - L[i])
    if a2 <= a1:
        a2 += 360.0
    am = (a1 + a2) / 2.0
    pm = L[i] + Vector(LOBE_R * math.cos(math.radians(am)),
                       LOBE_R * math.sin(math.radians(am)))
    edges.append(ThreePointArc(p1, pm, p2))

    # concave arc joining lobe i and lobe i+1
    q1 = tang(i, (i + 1) % 3)
    q2 = tang((i + 1) % 3, i)
    b1 = ang(q1 - Cc[i])
    b2 = ang(q2 - Cc[i])
    sweep = (b1 - b2) % 360.0
    bm = b1 - sweep / 2.0
    qm = Cc[i] + Vector(LOBE_R * math.cos(math.radians(bm)),
                        LOBE_R * math.sin(math.radians(bm)))
    edges.append(ThreePointArc(q1, qm, q2))

prof = make_face(Wire(edges))

# ---------------- solid ----------------
part = extrude(prof, THK)

# recessed web on the top face (leaves a 4.25 wide ring around each lobe)
pocket = offset(prof, amount=-RIM_W)
part -= Pos(0, 0, WEB) * extrude(pocket, RECESS)

# ---------------- 4 x O21.1 thru holes ----------------
for p in [Vector(0, 0)] + L:
    part -= Pos(p.X, p.Y, -1.0) * Cylinder(HOLE_R, THK + 2.0)

export_step(part, "output.step")

ridge_w     = 11.0       # hat ridge base width
ridge_top_w = 7.0        # hat ridge top width
r_corner    = 2.9        # 12x R2.9 / 4x R2.9
r_top       = 1.5
edge_gap    = 4.1        # ridge start from outer end of leaf
hole_d      = 1.6        # 4x dia 1.6 thru
hole_d_c    = 3.5        # dia 3.5 thru

ridge_len = leaf_len - 2*edge_gap - 4.0
ridge_cx  = -leaf_len/2 + edge_gap + ridge_len/2

# ---------------- one leaf ----------------
def make_leaf():
    with BuildPart() as bp:
        # base plate with R2.9 corners
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
            Rectangle(leaf_len, leaf_w)
            fillet(sk.vertices(), radius=r_corner)
        extrude(amount=t)

        # hat shaped ridge (lofted so the flanks are sloped)
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(t)):
            with Locations((ridge_cx, 0)):
                RectangleRounded(ridge_len, ridge_w, radius=r_corner)
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(t + ridge_h)):
            with Locations((ridge_cx, 0)):
                RectangleRounded(ridge_len - 1.6, ridge_top_w, radius=r_top)
        loft()

        # 2x dia 1.6 through ridge
        h1 = ridge_cx - ridge_len/2 + 4.5
        h2 = ridge_cx + ridge_len/2 - 4.5
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(t + ridge_h)):
            with Locations((h1, 0), (h2, 0)):
                Circle(hole_d/2)
        extrude(amount=-(t + ridge_h), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    return bp.part

leaf = make_leaf()

# ---------------- fold into an L ----------------
leaf1 = Pos(leaf_len/2, 0, 0) * leaf                       # horizontal leaf
leaf2 = Pos(leaf_len, 0, -leaf_len/2) * Rot(0, -90, 0) * leaf  # vertical leaf

part = leaf1 + leaf2

# ---------------- dia 3.5 thru near the hinge ----------------
part -= Pos(35.0, 0, 4.0) * Cylinder(radius=hole_d_c/2, height=14)

def oct_pts(dx, dy, c):
    """Octagon outline points with corner chamfers of length c."""
    hx, hy = dx / 2.0, dy / 2.0
    return [(-hx + c, -hy), ( hx - c, -hy),
            ( hx,     -hy + c), ( hx,      hy - c),
            ( hx - c,  hy),    (-hx + c,  hy),
            (-hx,      hy - c), (-hx,     -hy + c)]


def poly_face(pts, z):
    return Face(Wire.make_polygon([Vector(x, y, z) for (x, y) in pts], close=True))

             poly_face(oct_pts(top_x,  top_y,  chamfer), height)])

# giving 40 mm between adjacent hole centres (matches the 40 dim).
bc_r = BC_D / 2.0
hole_positions = []
for ang in (45.0, 135.0, 225.0, 315.0):
    a = math.radians(ang)
    hole_positions.append((bc_r * math.cos(a), bc_r * math.sin(a)))

# ---------------- Solid ----------------
part = Box(L, W, H, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# 12x R4 fillets on all block edges
part = fillet(part.edges(), radius=EDGE_R)

        HOLE_D / 2.0, H, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)
    )
    part = part - cbore - thru

from build123d import *
import math

# Given dimensions
flange_d = 74.9        # base flange diameter
body_d = 54.5          # outer diameter of the ribbed section
total_h = 90.8         # overall height

# Inferred dimensions (not explicitly dimensioned)
flange_t = 10.0        # base flange thickness
wall_t = 5.0           # radial wall thickness of the ribs
gap_angle = 20.0       # angular width of each slot (degrees)
num_slots = 6          # number of slots / ribs

# Derived values
outer_r = body_d / 2.0
inner_r = outer_r - wall_t
rib_h = total_h - flange_t
half_gap = gap_angle / 2.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: create a planar face of an annular sector (on XY plane)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
def annular_sector_face(r_in, r_out, start_deg, end_deg):
    """Return a Face that is an annular sector spanning start_deg to end_deg."""
    arc_out = CenterArc((0, 0), r_out, start_angle=start_deg,
                        arc_size=(end_deg - start_deg))
    p_out_start = arc_out @ 0
    p_out_end = arc_out @ 1

    ang_start = math.radians(start_deg)
    ang_end = math.radians(end_deg)
    p_in_start = (r_in * math.cos(ang_start), r_in * math.sin(ang_start))
    p_in_end = (r_in * math.cos(ang_end), r_in * math.sin(ang_end))

    line1 = Line(p_out_end, p_in_end)
    arc_in = CenterArc((0, 0), r_in, start_angle=end_deg,
                       arc_size=(start_deg - end_deg))
    line2 = Line(p_in_start, p_out_start)

    wire = Wire([arc_out, line1, arc_in, line2])
    return Face(wire)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1. Base flange (solid cylinder)
base = extrude(Circle(flange_d / 2.0), amount=flange_t)

# 2. Full hollow tube for the ribbed section
outer_tube = extrude(Circle(outer_r), amount=rib_h)
inner_bore = extrude(Circle(inner_r), amount=rib_h)
tube = outer_tube - inner_bore
tube = Pos(0, 0, flange_t) * tube

# 3. Create one slot cutting tool (annular sector) and replicate it
slot_face = annular_sector_face(inner_r, outer_r, -half_gap, half_gap)
slot_solid = extrude(slot_face, amount=rib_h)
slot_solid = Pos(0, 0, flange_t) * slot_solid

# Subtract the slots from the tube
for i in range(num_slots):
    angle = i * (360.0 / num_slots)
    slot_rot = Rot(Z=angle) * slot_solid
    tube = tube - slot_rot

# 4. Combine base and ribbed tube
part = base + tube

# 5. Export
export_step(part, "output.step")

def annular_sector(r_in, r_out, span_deg, center_deg=0.0):
    """Create a 2D annular sector face."""
    a1 = radians(center_deg - span_deg / 2)
    a2 = radians(center_deg + span_deg / 2)
    pts = [
        (r_in * cos(a1), r_in * sin(a1)),
        (r_out * cos(a1), r_out * sin(a1)),
        (r_out * cos(a2), r_out * sin(a2)),
        (r_in * cos(a2), r_in * sin(a2)),
    ]
    with BuildSketch() as sk:

        make_face()

from build123d import *
import math

# --- Dimensions from drawing ---
outer_dia   = 79.9               # Ø79.9
R_out       = outer_dia / 2.0
axial_thk   = 8.9                # 8.9 thickness
ribbon_w    = 3.2                # 7x R3.2
n_turns     = 7                  # spiral turns
r_inner     = 4.0                # starting inner radius

# --- Build a closed spiral ribbon profile ---
N = 480
pts = []

# Outer edge (inner -> outer)
for i in range(N + 1):
    t = i / N
    theta = 2.0 * math.pi * n_turns * t
    r_c = r_inner + (R_out - ribbon_w / 2.0 - r_inner) * t
    r_o = r_c + ribbon_w / 2.0
    pts.append((r_o * math.cos(theta), r_o * math.sin(theta)))

# Inner edge (outer -> inner)
for i in range(N + 1):
    t = 1.0 - i / N
    theta = 2.0 * math.pi * n_turns * t
    r_c = r_inner + (R_out - ribbon_w / 2.0 - r_inner) * t
    r_i = r_c - ribbon_w / 2.0
    pts.append((r_i * math.cos(theta), r_i * math.sin(theta)))

with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*pts, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=axial_thk)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
from math import sin, cos, pi, radians, hypot

# --- Printed dimensions ---
OUTER_DIA = 79.9
THICKNESS = 8.9
SLOT_WIDTH = 9.6
R_OUT = OUTER_DIA / 2.0

# Approximate spiral-slot start/end radii and angular layout
R_INNER = 4.8          # creates the small central triangular opening
R_OUTER_SLOT = R_OUT - 3.2   # leaves a small outer rim
THETA_START = radians(40.3)
THETA_SPAN = radians(159.1)

# --- Build spiral centerline and offset it to slot width ---
N = 100
pts = []
for i in range(N + 1):
    t = i / N
    r = R_INNER + (R_OUTER_SLOT - R_INNER) * t
    a = THETA_START + THETA_SPAN * t
    pts.append((r * cos(a), r * sin(a)))

left = []
right = []
for i in range(N + 1):
    if i == 0:
        dx = pts[1][0] - pts[0][0]
        dy = pts[1][1] - pts[0][1]
    elif i == N:
        dx = pts[N][0] - pts[N - 1][0]
        dy = pts[N][1] - pts[N - 1][1]
    else:
        dx = pts[i + 1][0] - pts[i - 1][0]
        dy = pts[i + 1][1] - pts[i - 1][1]
    L = hypot(dx, dy)
    nx, ny = -dy / L, dx / L
    left.append((pts[i][0] + nx * SLOT_WIDTH / 2.0,
                 pts[i][1] + ny * SLOT_WIDTH / 2.0))
    right.append((pts[i][0] - nx * SLOT_WIDTH / 2.0,
                  pts[i][1] - ny * SLOT_WIDTH / 2.0))

right.reverse()
profile = left + right

# --- Build the solid ---
base = extrude(Circle(R_OUT), amount=THICKNESS)

# One spiral slot as a solid
wire = Wire(Polyline(*profile, close=True))
slot_face = Face(wire)
slot_solid = extrude(slot_face, amount=THICKNESS)

# Three equally spaced spiral slots
cutter = slot_solid + Rot(Z=120) * slot_solid + Rot(Z=240) * slot_solid

part = base - cutter

export_step(part, "output.step")

H = 45.1          # overall height  (Z)

wall_t = 9.5      # upstanding end-wall thickness
wall_h = H        # upstanding end-wall height

# ---------------- Wall holes ----------------
wall_hole_d = 8.7     # 2x Ø8.7 THRU
wall_hole_z = 30.6    # hole centre height

# ---------------- Pads / counterbored holes ----------------
pad_h  = 13.1                 # "13.1 HIGH"
pad_d  = 19.0                 # pad outer diameter
thru_d = 4.7                  # 4x / 2x Ø4.7 THRU
cb1_d, cb1_t = 13.1, 7.3      # 4x counterbore
cb2_d, cb2_t = 11.6, 7.3      # 2x counterbore

# Hole layout : 2 rows (Y) x 3 columns (X), 40.0 apart in X
row_y   = (13.1, 52.4)
col_x   = (20.0, 40.0, 60.0)

corner_pos = [(x, y) for x in (col_x[0], col_x[2]) for y in row_y]   # 4x Ø13.1
mid_pos    = [(col_x[1], y) for y in row_y]                          # 2x Ø11.6

# ---------------- Base plate ----------------
part = Box(L, W, base_t, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- Upstanding end walls ----------------
for x0 in (0.0, L - wall_t):
    part += Pos(x0, 0, 0) * Box(wall_t, W, wall_h,
                                align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- Drill the wall holes (axis along X) ----------------
for xc in (wall_t / 2.0, L - wall_t / 2.0):
    part -= Pos(xc, W / 2.0, wall_hole_z) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(
        wall_hole_d / 2.0, wall_t * 3.0)

# ---------------- Raised pads on the base ----------------
for (x, y) in corner_pos + mid_pos:
    part += Pos(x, y, base_t) * Cylinder(
        pad_d / 2.0, pad_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- Through holes ----------------
for (x, y) in corner_pos + mid_pos:
    part -= Pos(x, y, -1.0) * Cylinder(thru_d / 2.0, base_t + pad_h + 2.0)

# ---------------- Counterbores ----------------
for (x, y) in corner_pos:
    part -= Pos(x, y, base_t + pad_h - cb1_t) * Cylinder(cb1_d / 2.0, cb1_t + 1.0)
for (x, y) in mid_pos:
    part -= Pos(x, y, base_t + pad_h - cb2_t) * Cylinder(cb2_d / 2.0, cb2_t + 1.0)

# ---------------- C4.4 chamfer around the base plate bottom ----------------
bottom_edges = part.edges().filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6 and e.length > 1e-6)
part = chamfer(bottom_edges, 2.2)   # relief chamfer on base perimeter

part = part.clean()

export_step(part, "output.step")

    # -----------------------------------------------------------
    blocks = [

        (14.0, 23.7,  2.0, W-2.0,  H_mid),  # mid block (inset)
        (23.7, 33.4,  0.0, W,      H),      # tall block

        (66.4, 80.0,  0.0, W,      H),      # right end wall

    for x0, x1, y0, y1, zt in blocks:
        with Locations((x0, y0, H_base)):
            Box(x1 - x0, y1 - y0, zt - H_base,
                align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

    # -----------------------------------------------------------
    # Cylindrical boss  (10.6 HIGH, Ø10.5 bore)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------
    boss_cx = 57.0

# --- Primary dimensions ---
L = 80.0            # overall length  (X)
W = 23.8            # overall width   (Y)

H_TOTAL = 18.0      # raised wall height
H_BOSS = 10.6       # boss height above main body

BIG_HOLE_D = 10.5   # cylindrical boss bore
SMALL_HOLE_D = 3.2  # corner bolt holes
CHAM_SMALL = 1.0    # C1.0 corner hole chamfers
CHAM_BIG = 2.6      # C2.6 wall chamfers

# --- Base plate ---
part = Box(L, W, H_MAIN, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# --- Raised end wall (from X=75.7 to X=80, up to 18.0 high) ---
wall_len = L - 75.7
wall = Box(wall_len, W, H_TOTAL - H_MAIN,
           align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
part += Pos(75.7, 0, H_MAIN) * wall

# --- Rectangular bosses (10.6 tall) on top of base ---
boss_positions = [4.3, 14.0, 30.5, 66.4]
boss_len = 8.0
boss_y0 = 2.0
boss_y1 = W - 2.0
for x in boss_positions:
    b = Box(boss_len, boss_y1 - boss_y0, H_BOSS,
            align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
    part += Pos(x, boss_y0, H_MAIN) * b

# --- Cylindrical boss with Ø10.5 through hole ---
cyl_r = 7.0
cyl_cx = 55.0
cyl = Cylinder(cyl_r, H_BOSS, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part += Pos(cyl_cx, W / 2, H_MAIN) * cyl

bore = Cylinder(BIG_HOLE_D / 2, H_BOSS + 2,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part -= Pos(cyl_cx, W / 2, H_MAIN - 1) * bore

# --- Small rectangular pocket (10.6 HIGH feature at X~35) ---
pocket = Box(6.0, 6.0, 3.0, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
part -= Pos(35.0, (W - 6.0) / 2, H_MAIN - 3.0) * pocket

# --- 4× Ø3.2 thru holes with C1.0 chamfer ---
hole_xs = [4.0, L - 4.0]

            Location((hx, hy, H_MAIN - CHAM_SMALL)))

except Exception:
    pass

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ----- dimensions from drawing (mm) -----
SIZE = 80.0      # overall cube size (80.0 x 80.0 x 80.0)
WALL = 5.7       # wall thickness (5.7)
FILLET_R = 5.7   # 8x R5.7 outer fillets (4 vertical + 4 top edges)

# ----- outer shell: 80 cube, open at the front (-Y) -----
outer = Box(SIZE, SIZE, SIZE, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
outer = fillet(outer.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), FILLET_R)          # 4 vertical edges
outer = fillet(outer.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1], FILLET_R)       # 4 top edges

# ----- inner cavity, wall thickness 5.7, open at front -----
PROTRUDE = 5.0                                       # extend cutter past the open face
cav = Box(SIZE - 2 * WALL, SIZE - WALL + PROTRUDE, SIZE - 2 * WALL,
          align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
cav = Pos(WALL, -PROTRUDE, WALL) * cav
cav = fillet(cav.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), FILLET_R)              # inner vertical corners
cav = fillet(cav.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[0], FILLET_R)            # inner floor fillet

part = outer - cav

# ----- internal partition wall, 5.7 thick, floor to ceiling -----
PART_W = WALL                       # 5.7 thick
PART_X = WALL + WALL                # 5.7 clear of the left inner wall
partition = Box(PART_W, SIZE - WALL, SIZE - 2 * WALL,
                align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
partition = Pos(PART_X, 0, WALL) * partition
part = part + partition

export_step(part, "output.step")

oy1, oy2 = t, W - t             # runs between front and back inner faces

profile = Circle(r_od)

    flute = Rot(0, 0, ang) * Pos(c, 0) * Circle(r_c)

import math

# ----- Dimensions from drawing -----
outer_dia = 80.0       # Ø80.0
root_dia = 53.0        # Ø53.0 (flute root diameter)
height = 23.6          # height
num_flutes = 13        # 13x
chamfer_size = 2.9     # C2.9
center_hole_dia = 13.0 # central hole

# ----- Base solid: cylinder with central through hole -----
base = Cylinder(outer_dia / 2, height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
hole = Cylinder(center_hole_dia / 2, height * 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
part = base - Pos(0, 0, height / 2) * hole

# ----- Flute cutters -----
cutter_radius = 8.0
valley_radius = root_dia / 2
D = valley_radius + cutter_radius

for i in range(num_flutes):
    angle = i * 360.0 / num_flutes
    cutter = Cylinder(cutter_radius, height * 3, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
    cutter = Pos(D, 0, 0) * cutter
    cutter = Rot(Z=angle) * cutter
    cutter = Pos(0, 0, height / 2) * cutter
    part = part - cutter

# ----- Chamfer the outer flute edges (top & bottom) -----
# Collect candidate edges on the top and bottom faces, excluding the center hole.
edges_to_chamfer = []
for e in part.edges():
    c = e.center()
    if abs(c.Z) < 1e-6 or abs(c.Z - height) < 1e-6:
        r_center = math.hypot(c.X, c.Y)
        # Skip edges that are part of the central hole
        if r_center > center_hole_dia / 2 + 1.0:
            edges_to_chamfer.append(e)

# Try chamfering all together first; if that fails, try each edge individually
try:
    part = chamfer(edges_to_chamfer, length=chamfer_size)
except Exception:
    # Attempt a slightly smaller chamfer as fallback
    success = False
    for size in (chamfer_size, chamfer_size * 0.75, chamfer_size * 0.5):
        try:
            part = chamfer(edges_to_chamfer, length=size)
            success = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue
    if not success:
        # Try individual edges
        for e in edges_to_chamfer:
            try:
                part = chamfer([e], length=chamfer_size)
            except Exception:
                pass

# ----- Export -----
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---- Dimensions (mm) ----
TIP_R = 80.0 / 2        # 40  outer radius across tooth tips
VALLEY_R = 35.0         # radius of the valley / base circle
TOOTH_R = 5.0           # radius of each rounded tooth lobe
N_TEETH = 13            # number of teeth (matches "13x")
HEIGHT = 23.6           # overall height
BORE_R = 53.0 / 2       # internal cavity diameter (hidden circle)
WEB_T = 4.0             # web thickness left at the top
HOLE_R = 16.0 / 2       # center hole through the web
CHAM = 2.9              # C2.9 chamfer on the teeth

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- outer lobed (splined) profile ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(VALLEY_R)
        with PolarLocations(VALLEY_R, N_TEETH):
            Circle(TOOTH_R)
    extrude(amount=HEIGHT)

    # ---- C2.9 chamfer: only on the 13 outer tooth arcs, top & bottom ----
    def is_tooth(e):
        return (
            e.geom_type == GeomType.CIRCLE
            and abs(e.radius - TOOTH_R) < 0.1
        )

    top_edges = bp.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    bot_edges = bp.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[0]
    tooth_edges = [e for e in list(top_edges) + list(bot_edges) if is_tooth(e)]

    chamfer(tooth_edges, length=CHAM)

    # ---- internal cavity Ø53 from the bottom ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(BORE_R)
    extrude(amount=-(HEIGHT - WEB_T), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- center hole through the web ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(HEIGHT - WEB_T)):
        Circle(HOLE_R)
    extrude(amount=-(WEB_T + 1.0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

    (0.0, 0.0),
    (leg_len, 0.0),
    (leg_len, leg_thk),
    (leg_thk, leg_thk),
    (leg_thk, leg_len),
    (0.0, leg_len),
]
face = make_face(Polyline(*profile_pts, close=True))
part = extrude(face, amount=width)

# ---- 2x R6.9 on the top corners of the vertical leg ----

    e for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.X)

        align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN),

# --- Dimensions from the drawing ---
back_w = 40.0      # width of back plate / overall width
back_h = 72.7      # overall height
back_t = 25.5      # back plate thickness (depth)
prong_l = 40.0     # prong length (65.5 - 25.5)
prong_w = 32.7     # prong width
prong_t = 7.3      # prong thickness (vertical)
gap = 18.2         # vertical gap between prongs
hole_d = 3.6       # hole through back plate

# --- Back plate (X = width, Y = depth, Z = height) ---
back = Pos(0, back_t / 2, back_h / 2) * Box(back_w, back_t, back_h)

# --- Prongs: extend forward (+Y) from front face of back plate ---
def make_prong(z_top):
    return Pos(0, back_t + prong_l / 2, z_top - prong_t / 2) * Box(prong_w, prong_l, prong_t)

top_prong = make_prong(back_h)                         # flush with top
mid_prong = make_prong(back_h - prong_t - gap)         # 18.2 below top prong
bottom_prong = make_prong(prong_t)                     # flush with bottom

part = back + top_prong + mid_prong + bottom_prong

# --- ø3.6 hole through the back plate (near upper left of front view) ---
hole = Pos(back_w / 2 - 7.3, back_t / 2, back_h - 20) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_d / 2, back_t + 2)
part = part - hole

export_step(part, "output.step")

from math import atan2, degrees, sqrt, hypot

# ---------------- dimensions from drawing ----------------
L      = 80.0     # overall profile length
H      = 34.8     # profile height
D      = 42.9     # extrusion depth

R_TOP  = 16.1     # R16.1 upper-left arc
R_TR   = 6.7      # R6.7 top-right corner
R_BR   = 2.7      # R2.7 bottom-right corner
R_BIG  = 56.2     # R56.2 right side arc
R_NOSE = 5.4      # 2x R5.4 nose corners

NOSE_H = 16.6     # nose height (scaled off front view)
NOSE_X = 24.0     # nose length / step position

top_y    = H
step_top = top_y - R_TOP      # vertical step top = 18.7 (tangency of R16.1)
arc_tan_x = NOSE_X + R_TOP    # top tangency of R16.1 = 40.1

# --- center of the R56.2 arc: internally tangent to both corner fillet circles ---
F1 = (L - R_TR, H - R_TR)     # center of R6.7 fillet
F2 = (L - R_BR, R_BR)         # center of R2.7 fillet
d1 = R_BIG - R_TR
d2 = R_BIG - R_BR

A_, B_  = F1
Cx_, Cy_ = F2
alpha = 2 * (Cx_ - A_)
beta  = 2 * (Cy_ - B_)
gamma = d1**2 - d2**2 - A_**2 + Cx_**2 - B_**2 + Cy_**2
p = -beta / alpha
q = gamma / alpha
a2 = p * p + 1.0
b2 = 2 * (p * (q - A_) - B_)
c2 = (q - A_)**2 + B_**2 - d1**2
disc = b2 * b2 - 4 * a2 * c2
cy = min((-b2 + s * sqrt(disc)) / (2 * a2) for s in (1, -1))
cx = p * cy + q
C = (cx, cy)

def ang(c, pt):
    return degrees(atan2(pt[1] - c[1], pt[0] - c[0]))

def tangent_point(F):
    d = hypot(F[0] - C[0], F[1] - C[1])
    return (C[0] + R_BIG * (F[0] - C[0]) / d, C[1] + R_BIG * (F[1] - C[1]) / d)

T2 = tangent_point(F2)   # lower tangency on big arc
T1 = tangent_point(F1)   # upper tangency on big arc

# ---------------- build part ----------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Line((R_NOSE, 0), (L - R_BR, 0))                                # bottom
            CenterArc(F2, R_BR, -90, ang(F2, T2) + 90)                      # R2.7 corner
            CenterArc(C, R_BIG, ang(C, T2), ang(C, T1) - ang(C, T2))        # R56.2 side
            CenterArc(F1, R_TR, ang(F1, T1), 90 - ang(F1, T1))              # R6.7 corner
            Line((L - R_TR, H), (arc_tan_x, H))                             # top

    extrude(amount=D)

import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
W = 80.0          # profile width  (X)
H = 34.8          # profile height (Y)
D = 42.9          # extrusion depth (Z)

R_LEFT   = 5.4    # 2x R5.4  (bottom-left and shelf-left corners)
R_CONC   = 16.1   # concave fillet between shelf and top edge
R_TRI    = 6.7    # top-right corner
R_BRI    = 2.7    # bottom-right corner
R_ARC    = 56.2   # right-hand side arc

# ---------------- derived profile geometry ----------------
shelf_y       = H - R_CONC        # 18.7  (tangent point of concave arc)
shelf_right_x = 16.0              # x where concave arc leaves the shelf
top_arc_x     = shelf_right_x + R_CONC   # 32.1 tangent point on top edge
P_TR          = (74.0, H)         # top-right corner (before fillet)
P_BR          = (W, 0.0)          # bottom-right corner (before fillet)

# center / midpoint of the R56.2 arc through P_BR and P_TR (bulging to +X)
def arc_center(p1, p2, r):
    mx, my = (p1[0] + p2[0]) / 2, (p1[1] + p2[1]) / 2
    dx, dy = p2[0] - p1[0], p2[1] - p1[1]
    L = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    d = math.sqrt(r * r - (L / 2) ** 2)
    ux, uy = dx / L, dy / L
    return (mx - d * uy, my + d * ux)          # center on -X side

C = arc_center(P_BR, P_TR, R_ARC)
mx, my = (P_BR[0] + P_TR[0]) / 2, (P_BR[1] + P_TR[1]) / 2
d_mc = math.hypot(mx - C[0], my - C[1])
ux, uy = (mx - C[0]) / d_mc, (my - C[1]) / d_mc
MID_RIGHT = (C[0] + R_ARC * ux, C[1] + R_ARC * uy)   # point on the big arc

# midpoint of the concave R16.1 arc (quarter circle, center (top_arc_x, shelf_y))
MID_CONC = (top_arc_x - R_CONC * math.cos(math.pi / 4),
            shelf_y   + R_CONC * math.sin(math.pi / 4))

def pick(shape, x, y, tol=1e-4):
    return shape.vertices().filter_by(
        lambda v: abs(v.X - x) < tol and abs(v.Y - y) < tol)

# ---------------- build part ----------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((0, 0), P_BR)                                   # bottom
            ThreePointArc(P_BR, MID_RIGHT, P_TR)                 # right R56.2 arc
            Line(P_TR, (top_arc_x, H))                           # top edge
            ThreePointArc((top_arc_x, H), MID_CONC,
                          (shelf_right_x, shelf_y))              # R16.1 concave
            Line((shelf_right_x, shelf_y), (0, shelf_y))         # shelf
            Line((0, shelf_y), (0, 0))                           # left edge
        make_face()
        fillet(pick(sk, 0, 0),            radius=R_LEFT)         # R5.4
        fillet(pick(sk, 0, shelf_y),      radius=R_LEFT)         # R5.4
        fillet(pick(sk, W, 0),            radius=R_BRI)          # R2.7
        fillet(pick(sk, P_TR[0], P_TR[1]), radius=R_TRI)         # R6.7
    extrude(amount=D)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

t = bar_width / math.cos(theta)          # height of vertical end faces (~12.62)

bar2 = Polygon((W, H), (0, t), (0, 0), (W, H - t), align=None)       # TR -> BL

x_profile = bar1 + bar2                  # union -> X shape

part = Pos(-W / 2, -H / 2, -thickness / 2) * part   # center at origin

# ---- dimensions (mm) ----
disc_dia        = 80.0     # overall diameter
boss_dia        = 40.0     # raised boss diameter
total_h         = 10.9     # overall height
boss_h          = 5.0      # boss height above plate face
plate_h         = total_h - boss_h      # 5.9 plate thickness
recess_dia      = 58.2     # bottom recess diameter
recess_depth    = total_h - 8.7         # 2.2 -> gives the 8.7 dim

big_hole_dia    = 10.9
big_hole_bc     = 43.6
big_hole_count  = 8

center_hole_dia = 8.0

small_hole_dia   = 3.6
small_hole_depth = 7.3
small_hole_bc    = 20.0
small_hole_count = 3
cham             = 0.7

with BuildPart() as pb:
    # main plate Ø80
    Cylinder(disc_dia / 2, plate_h,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # raised boss Ø40 x 5
    with Locations((0, 0, plate_h)):
        Cylinder(boss_dia / 2, boss_h,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # bottom recess Ø58.2 x 2.2
    Cylinder(recess_dia / 2, recess_depth,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
             mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 8 x Ø10.9 thru holes on Ø43.6 BC
    with PolarLocations(big_hole_bc / 2, big_hole_count):
        Cylinder(big_hole_dia / 2, total_h + 2,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # central Ø8 hole
    Cylinder(center_hole_dia / 2, total_h + 2,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER),
             mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 3 x Ø3.6 holes, 7.3 deep from boss top
    with Locations((0, 0, total_h - small_hole_depth)):
        with PolarLocations(small_hole_bc / 2, small_hole_count):
            Cylinder(small_hole_dia / 2, small_hole_depth + 1,
                     align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                     mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # C0.7 chamfers on the three small holes
    top_hole_edges = pb.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).filter_by(
        lambda e: abs(e.radius - small_hole_dia / 2) < 1e-6
        and abs(e.center().Z - total_h) < 1e-6)
    if top_hole_edges:
        chamfer(top_hole_edges, length=cham)

part = pb.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

                                      BODY_H - FLOOR_Z + 1.0,
                                      align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

plate_dia = 80.0        # outer diameter of base plate
plate_thk = 5.0         # base plate thickness

step_dia = 58.2         # raised step diameter
step_height = 8.7       # top of step from bottom face

hub_dia = 40.0          # central hub diameter
total_height = 10.9     # overall height

hole_dia = 10.9         # bolt holes
bc_dia = 43.6           # bolt circle diameter
num_holes = 8

center_hole_dia = 3.6   # central hole
center_hole_depth = 7.3 # central hole depth from top

cham = 0.7              # C0.7 chamfers

with BuildPart() as p:
    # Base plate
    Cylinder(plate_dia / 2, plate_thk,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    # Raised step
    Cylinder(step_dia / 2, step_height,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    # Central hub
    Cylinder(hub_dia / 2, total_height,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # Central blind hole (Ø3.6 x 7.3 deep from the top face)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(total_height)):
        Circle(center_hole_dia / 2)
    extrude(amount=-center_hole_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 3 x C0.7 chamfers: step top edge, hub top edge, center hole top edge
    cham_edges = []
    for e in p.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE):
        z = e.center().Z
        r = e.radius
        if abs(z - step_height) < 1e-6 and abs(r - step_dia / 2) < 1e-6:
            cham_edges.append(e)
        elif abs(z - total_height) < 1e-6 and (
                abs(r - hub_dia / 2) < 1e-6 or
                abs(r - center_hole_dia / 2) < 1e-6):
            cham_edges.append(e)
    chamfer(cham_edges, length=cham)

    # 8 x Ø10.9 through holes on Ø43.6 bolt circle
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with PolarLocations(bc_dia / 2, num_holes, start_angle=90):
            Circle(hole_dia / 2)
    extrude(amount=total_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

TAB_W = 40.0                 # tab width
TAB_TOP_R = TAB_W / 2.0      # tab top radius
HOLE_D = 8.0                 # 2x Ø8.0 THRU
SMALL_HOLE_D = 4.8           # Ø4.8 THRU
CENTER_Y = H_AF - W / 2.0    # 28.1
CHAMFER = 0.3                # 12x C0.3

# Derived chord half-width where the flat meets the circular base
DX = math.sqrt((W / 2.0) ** 2 - CENTER_Y ** 2)

with BuildPart() as part_builder:
    # Base: semicircular disk with flat top, thickness T
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Line((-DX, CENTER_Y), (DX, CENTER_Y))
            ThreePointArc((DX, CENTER_Y), (0.0, CENTER_Y - W / 2.0), (-DX, CENTER_Y))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=T / 2.0, both=True)

    # Tab: rectangular extension with rounded top
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations((0.0, CENTER_Y)):
            Rectangle(TAB_W, 40.0, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
            with Locations((0.0, 40.0)):
                Circle(TAB_TOP_R)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=T / 2.0, both=True)

    # Holes: 2x Ø8.0 THRU along thickness
    with Locations(Plane.XZ.offset(T / 2.0 + 0.1)):
        with Locations((0.0, CENTER_Y + 40.0)):
            Hole(HOLE_D / 2.0, depth=T + 0.2)

        with Locations((0.0, 0.0)):
            Hole(SMALL_HOLE_D / 2.0, depth=T + 0.2)

    # 12x C0.3 chamfer on all external edges
    chamfer(part_builder.edges(), length=CHAMFER)

export_step(part, "output.step")

x1, y1 = 0.0, 0.0
x2, y2 = D, -H

# Chord length

# Central angle of the centerline arc
theta = 2.0 * math.asin(chord / (2.0 * R_c))

# Midpoint of chord
mx = (x1 + x2) / 2.0
my = (y1 + y2) / 2.0

# Perpendicular direction pointing to the centre (right side)
vx = x2 - x1
vy = y2 - y1
px = -vy
py = vx
plen = math.hypot(px, py)
px /= plen
py /= plen

# Distance from chord midpoint to centre
d = R_c * math.cos(theta / 2.0)

# Centre of the arc
cx = mx + px * d
cy = my + py * d

# Angles of the centerline endpoints

ang2 = math.atan2(y2 - cy, x2 - cx)

    ang2 += 2.0 * math.pi

from build123d import *

# ---------------- Dimensions (mm) ----------------
total_length = 80.0        # overall length  (x)
total_height = 53.3        # overall height  (y)
total_depth  = 29.6        # overall depth   (z)

base_r       = 26.7        # R26.7 rounded end of base (in XY)
base_ctr_x   = 26.7        # hole/arc center from left edge
hole_d       = 13.3        # Ø13.3 THRU (both holes)

ear_end_r    = 14.8        # 2x R14.8 rounded ear ends (in XZ)
ear_hole_x   = 65.2        # ear hole center from left edge (65.2 + 14.8 = 80)

gap_h        = 26.7        # fork opening height
gap_y0       = (total_height - gap_h) / 2.0   # 13.3
gap_y1       = gap_y0 + gap_h                 # 40.0

cy = total_height / 2.0    # 26.65
cz = total_depth  / 2.0    # 14.8

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # U-shaped plate profile (XY plane), extruded through the full depth
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        # the two forked arms
        with Locations(((base_ctr_x + total_length) / 2.0, cy)):
            Rectangle(total_length - base_ctr_x, total_height)
        # rounded base end R26.7
        with Locations((base_ctr_x, cy)):
            Circle(base_r)
        # fork slot 26.7 high, open at the right end
        with Locations(((base_ctr_x + total_length) / 2.0, (gap_y0 + gap_y1) / 2.0)):
            Rectangle(total_length - base_ctr_x, gap_h, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=total_depth)

part = bp.part

# ---- Round both ear ends with R14.8 (semicircular ends in the XZ plane) ----
corner_box = Pos(ear_hole_x + (total_length - ear_hole_x) / 2.0, cy, cz) * \
             Box(total_length - ear_hole_x, 200, total_depth)
end_cyl    = Pos(ear_hole_x, cy, cz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(ear_end_r, 200)
part -= (corner_box - end_cyl)

# ---- Ø13.3 ear holes (coaxial through both ears, along Y) ----
part -= Pos(ear_hole_x, cy, cz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_d / 2.0, 200)

# ---- Ø13.3 through hole in the rounded base (along Z) ----
part -= Pos(base_ctr_x, cy, cz) * Cylinder(hole_d / 2.0, 200)

export_step(part, "output.step")

import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
tip_radius     = 40.0        # distance from center to lobe tip (40.0)
overall_width  = 80.0        # overall width across the tri-lobe (80.0)
lobe_radius    = 40.4        # 3× R40.4 outer lobe arcs
hole_dia       = 22.4        # central through hole Ø22.4
height         = 21.1        # part thickness / height
lobe_angle     = 120.0        # angular spacing between the three lobes
side_width     = 73.1        # width in the side view
hex_af         = 40.4        # hexagonal pocket across flats (40.4 side dimension)
hex_depth      = 10.0        # not explicitly dimensioned; used for the top hex recess

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tri-lobe outer profile
# Each lobe is a circular arc of radius R40.4.
# The centers are offset by e = R40.4 - 40.0 = 0.4 from the center,
# in the direction opposite each lobe tip.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
e = lobe_radius - tip_radius   # 0.4 mm

centers = []
for i in range(3):
    ang = 90 + i * lobe_angle
    cx = -e * math.cos(math.radians(ang))
    cy = -e * math.sin(math.radians(ang))
    centers.append((cx, cy))

with BuildPart() as part_builder:
    # Outer tri-lobe solid
    with BuildSketch() as outer_sk:
        for cx, cy in centers:
            with Locations((cx, cy)):
                Circle(lobe_radius)
    extrude(amount=height)

    # Central through hole Ø22.4
    with Locations((0, 0, 0)):
        Hole(radius=hole_dia / 2)

    # Top hexagonal socket (across flats = 40.4)
    # RegularPolygon with major_radius=False uses the apothem as radius.
    hex_circumradius = hex_af / math.sqrt(3)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(height)) as hex_sk:
        RegularPolygon(
            radius=hex_circumradius,
            side_count=6,
            major_radius=False,
        )
    extrude(amount=-hex_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = part_builder.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ------------------- Dimensions from the drawing -------------------
overall_width = 80.0          # across the two lower lobes
lobe_radius   = 40.4          # 3x R40.4
thickness     = 21.1          # part height
hole_dia      = 22.4          # Ø22.4 THRU
pocket_af     = 40.4          # hex pocket across-flats (from side view)
pocket_depth  = 12.0          # estimated pocket depth

# The outer profile is a tri-lobe made of three circles of radius R=40.4.
# The centres are placed at distance c from the part centre so that the
# distance between two adjacent lobe tips (120° apart) equals 80.
#   width = 2 * (c + R) * sin(60°) = 80
c = overall_width / (2 * sin(radians(60))) - lobe_radius   # ≈ 5.788

# Centres: one lobe pointing up (90°), two lobes down (210°, 330°)
centres = [
    (0.0, c),                          # 90°
    (-c * cos(radians(30)), -c * sin(radians(30))),   # 210°
    ( c * cos(radians(30)), -c * sin(radians(30))),   # 330°
]

# Build the outer profile as the union of three circles
circles = [
    Pos(x, y) * Circle(lobe_radius)
    for x, y in centres
]
profile = circles[0] + circles[1] + circles[2]

# Extrude the tri-lobe profile
part = extrude(profile, thickness)

# Central through hole
part -= Cylinder(radius=hole_dia / 2, height=thickness, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# Hexagonal pocket on the top face
hex_radius = pocket_af / sqrt(3)      # circumradius from across-flats
pocket = Pos(0, 0, thickness) * extrude(
    RegularPolygon(radius=hex_radius, side_count=6, major_radius=True),
    -pocket_depth,
)
part -= pocket

# Export the final solid
export_step(part, "output.step")

edge_r      = 7.5      # R7.5

R_out  = outer_dia / 2
R_hole = hole_dia / 2
R_dish = dish_dia / 2
z_top  = thickness
z_in   = thickness - dish_depth   # depth of the dish at the hole

# sphere whose surface passes through (R_dish, z_top) and (R_hole, z_in), centre on the axis
zc  = ((R_dish**2 - R_hole**2) + (z_top**2 - z_in**2)) / (2.0 * (z_top - z_in))
R_s = math.hypot(R_dish, z_top - zc)

a0  = math.atan2(z_top - zc, R_dish)
a1  = math.atan2(z_in - zc, R_hole)
am  = (a0 + a1) / 2.0
mid = (R_s * math.cos(am), zc + R_s * math.sin(am))

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # revolved cross-section (radius / height plane)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((R_hole, 0), (R_out, 0))                 # flat back face
            Line((R_out, 0), (R_out, z_top))              # outer cylindrical rim
            Line((R_out, z_top), (R_dish, z_top))         # flat annular rim face
            ThreePointArc((R_dish, z_top), mid, (R_hole, z_in))  # dished face

# Overall dimensions
length = 80.0      # overall length (X)
depth = 33.0       # overall depth (Y)
height = 29.0      # overall height (Z)
wall = 3.0         # wall thickness (the "3" dimension)
rail_h = 12.0      # height of the top rail (the "12" dimension)
floor_h = height - rail_h   # solid lower portion height

slot_w = 58.0      # slot width in the top rail (the "58" dimension)
slot_left = 19.0   # slot offset from left edge (the "19" dimension)

# Outer body
part = Box(length, depth, height, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# Hollow out the interior from the top, leaving floor + 3 mm walls
cavity = Box(length - 2 * wall, depth - 2 * wall, height - floor_h,
             align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
cavity = Pos(wall, wall, floor_h) * cavity
part -= cavity

# Central transverse divider wall
divider = Box(wall, depth - 2 * wall, height - floor_h,
              align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
divider = Pos(length / 2 - wall / 2, wall, floor_h) * divider
part += divider

# Slot through the top rail (front and back walls), 58 wide, 19 from left
slot = Box(slot_w, depth + 2, rail_h, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
slot = Pos(slot_left, -1, floor_h) * slot
part -= slot

export_step(part, "output.step")

DEPTH     = 22.2      # total out-of-plane depth (sagitta)
THICKNESS = 2.0       # assumed uniform wall thickness

FLAT_W   = WIDTH - R_SEMI        # 17.5  width of flat rectangular portion
CENTER_X = FLAT_W                # 17.5  X of semicircle centre
CENTER_Y = HEIGHT / 2.0          # 40.0  Y of semicircle centre

# Sphere radius that gives a sagitta of DEPTH over a chord of R_SEMI
R_DOME = (DEPTH**2 + R_SEMI**2) / (2.0 * DEPTH)
DIST   = R_DOME - DEPTH          # distance from sphere centre to flat plane

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    # D-shaped prism (flat bottom at Z = 0, extruded upward by DEPTH)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with Locations((FLAT_W / 2, HEIGHT / 2)):
            Rectangle(FLAT_W, HEIGHT)
        with Locations((CENTER_X, CENTER_Y)):
            Circle(R_SEMI)
        with Locations((CENTER_X - R_SEMI / 2, CENTER_Y)):
            Rectangle(R_SEMI, R_SEMI * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=DEPTH)

    # Intersect with a large sphere to create the domed top surface
    with Locations((CENTER_X, CENTER_Y, -DIST)):
        Sphere(R_DOME, mode=Mode.INTERSECT)

part_solid = bp.part

bottom_face = part_solid.faces().filter_by(Plane.XY).sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
part = offset(part_solid, amount=-THICKNESS, openings=bottom_face, kind=Kind.ARC)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper : annular sector face
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
def sector(r_i, r_o, a0, a1):
    """Flat annular sector between angles a0 -> a1 (degrees), radii r_i .. r_o"""
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        with BuildLine():
            outer = CenterArc((0, 0), r_o, a0, a1 - a0)
            Line(outer @ 1, (r_i * cos(radians(a1)), r_i * sin(radians(a1))))
            inner = CenterArc((0, 0), r_i, a1, a0 - a1)
            Line(inner @ 1, outer @ 0)
        make_face()
    return s.sketch

inner_face = Polygon(*inner_pts, align=None)

from math import tan, radians

# ---------------- Overall block ----------------
width   = 80.0     # X extent
depth   = 49.2     # Y extent
height  = 49.2     # Z extent

# ---------------- Notch (pocket) ----------------
notch_left_x    = 34.4                       # left limit of notch at the top face
notch_width_top = 33.3                       # top opening width
notch_right_x   = notch_left_x + notch_width_top   # = 67.7 (= 80 - 12.3)
notch_depth_y   = 12.3                       # pocket depth from the front face
notch_floor_z   = 12.3                       # pocket floor height

# Chamfer on the left wall of the notch: 10.3 x 43.5 deg
chamfer_run  = 10.3
chamfer_ang  = 43.5
chamfer_drop = chamfer_run * tan(radians(chamfer_ang))
notch_wall_x = notch_left_x + chamfer_run    # vertical wall position = 44.7

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # base block
    Box(width, depth, height, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

    # notch profile in the XZ plane, extruded into the front face
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (notch_left_x,  height),
                (notch_wall_x,  height - chamfer_drop),
                (notch_wall_x,  notch_floor_z),
                (notch_right_x, notch_floor_z),
                (notch_right_x, height),
                (notch_left_x,  height),
            )
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=-notch_depth_y, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

)

outer_h = 54.5      # overall height

right_t = 3.8       # front border, right
top_t = 2.7         # front border, top
bot_t = 3.2         # front border, bottom

front_open_h = outer_h - top_t - bot_t      # 48.6
